title: Cumulative Sum
text: Cumulative sum of channel, column, or row elements, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset type; {Sum input along} sets the dimension to sum along Channels, {Input processing} sets the method to process the input Columns, {Rounding mode}, {Saturate on integer overflow} saturates for fixed-point operation, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulator, {Output} sets the data type of output, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value the block can output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value block can output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sum input along
params.values: Dimension to sum along Channels (running sum) (default) | Columns | Rows

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset type None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate for fixed-point operation off (default) | on

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulator Inherit: Same as first input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value the block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value block can output [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
